purpose: Small source-locked SEC event-to-research-ledger workflow panel; no trading or return prediction

cases.seed_thesis: Revenue growth with stable or improving GAAP gross margin supports the growth thesis. Gaming revenue has been weak and remains a segment-mix risk until sustained recovery is evidenced. Assess each new filing against both conditions.
seed_catalysts: revenue growth with non-declining GAAP gross margin

oracle.risk_to_identify: Gaming recovery in one quarter does not establish sustained segment recovery
oracle.conviction_constraint: explain any change rather than assume it

cases.seed_thesis: Revenue and gross-margin improvement support the growth thesis, but Gaming revenue deterioration remains a material segment-mix risk. Reassess both sides after each filing.

oracle.risk_to_identify: Gaming revenue fell despite higher total revenue and margin
oracle.conviction_constraint: explain any change rather than assume it

cases.seed_thesis: A recovery thesis depends on stabilizing sales, GAAP gross margin, and digital-channel trends. A later filing showing simultaneous lower revenue and gross margin with a deeper digital contraction would materially challenge it.
seed_invalidations: lower revenue and gross margin alongside a deeper digital contraction in a later selected filing

oracle.period_warning: Q4 FY2024 and Q2 FY2025 are nonconsecutive selected observations; do not call the comparison quarter over quarter
oracle.risk_to_identify: weaker sales, margin, and digital channel together
oracle.conviction_constraint: lower conviction or explicitly justify invalidation

cases.seed_thesis: Data Center and total revenue growth support the thesis only if GAAP gross-margin resilience also remains established. A new event packet that lacks a margin observation is insufficient to conclude that the margin condition was met.
seed_catalysts: revenue and Data Center growth with demonstrated margin resilience

oracle.risk_to_identify: the supplied event packet omits Q2 gross margin; do not claim the SEC filing itself omitted it
oracle.conviction_constraint: unchanged until missing metric is checked
